clean_source_replay.execution_note: The first wrapper failed only because the requested publication test module name did not exist; its original failed log is preserved. The existing test_public_artifacts module was then executed without source changes and passed.

scope: Twelve fixed public Legacy/V2 fixtures retain exact 50-field callback and native trace requirements.
Four display modes additionally require a fresh current-source/current-run/current-attempt/nonce-bound Quick Look receipt.
The observer is bounded to 22 seconds, six swipes and sixteen observations and checks current foreground ownership before interaction.
Only reviewed titles and five fixed visible-label Boolean slots are recorded; no raw title, accessibility tree, source screenshot or image is published.
Native semantic callback failure cannot be replaced by preview success; plain modes require the exact semantic callback without inventing a preview.
Creation Date display suffix and second-precision Date comparison do not independently prove an arbitrary Date payload or physical-device behavior.
peer_review_controls: An owned preview followed by an unrelated sheet with a Done button loses ownership.
An app.state response arriving after the deadline does not permit a new action.
Non-overlapping receipt timings and action completion intervals bind to observed total elapsed.
Non-dated modes reject an observed date suffix.
Source-bound helper intake rejects fake callback success and a borrowed workflow attempt.
